title: Read-only advisory routing for bounded model and worker orchestration
summary: ValueRoute answers whether a multi-agent task should stay on the host controller or be split across workers, and how many. v0.0.2 adds the read-only /v1/advisory pipeline (boundary classification, requirement profiler, candidate suggestions with cost and latency estimates, durable shadow records) on top of the v0.0.1 local coordination slice (journal, leases, workspaces, integration, recovery). Automatic delegation stays disabled: advisory only recommends, and the offline evaluation set is now in place to judge gains before anything auto-delegates.
highlights: Read-only advisory routing: classify the request boundary, profile a requirement graph, and get direct-vs-workers candidates with estimated tokens, cost, latency, confidence, and rejection reasons.
Durable shadow records: every unexecuted advice is journaled with a stable request fingerprint and survives restart, ready for offline comparison against real outcomes.
Idempotency-Key-protected /v1/advisory API with versioned v1 request schema artifacts checked against Pydantic and OpenAPI.

Offline evaluation set: three frozen task families (backend/API diagnosis, frontend browser verification, disjoint full-stack) with ground-truth delegation and A/B/C live measurements; first run archived in evaluation/evidence/.
Local coordination core from v0.0.1: append-only checksummed journal, region writer leases, isolated workspaces with atomic integration and parent verification, 0-5 worker queue with kill-9 recovery.
36-item design acceptance checklist verified; CI (pytest on Python 3.11 + ruff) added.
Simplified-Chinese README (README.zh-CN.md) alongside the English one.
verification: Design section 23 acceptance checklist: 36 of 36 items verified
First live offline evaluation (2026-08-15, gpt-5-6-mini): A/B/C pass 4/7/5 at ~$0.019 / $0.035 / $0.037; advisory delegation 6/15 correct, 5/15 over-delegated, 4/15 under-delegated
compatibility: Python 3.11+ (tests run on 3.11 in CI; 3.10 development environment)
Local single-process orchestration only; no database or Redis required
OpenAI-compatible endpoint via chat/completions for the evaluation harness
limitations: Advisory mode is read-only: it never registers a controller, never creates a WorkerPlan, and never changes model configuration.
Automatic delegation stays disabled until the offline evaluation set demonstrates quality, cost, or latency gains.
Evaluation acceptance is keyword-based, not full task execution; quality_claim is false and no model-quality certification is implied.
Production authentication and remote deployment hardening are outside this local-first release evidence.
The boundary classifier can misclassify a request containing a bare 'change' token as a material amendment, under-delegating some disjoint full-stack tasks (recorded in docs/evaluation.md).
